companies.name: Sasol (Sasol Delight convenience stores)
channel_category: petrol station and convenience chains
companies.distributes: Chocolate (Nestle Aero and Kit Kat, Cadbury Lunch Bar), sweets and gummies (Maynards, Allsorts, Mint Imperial, Mister Sweet), chewing gum and biscuits (Oreo), plus drinks and hot food
companies.channels_supplied: Sasol Delight shops at Sasol Convenience Centres across South Africa, owner-operated under Sasol's franchise format
companies.fit_rationale: Sasol's own website runs Sasol Delight shop promotions on branded chocolate, sweets, gum and biscuits, including a Tiger Brands sweets deal valid to September 2026, so the chain buys and sells other companies' confectionery. Engineering News reported 409 Sasol Convenience Centres, each with a convenience shop, run under one franchise format, which gives a national buying point.
what_they_do_well: Runs national supplier promotions in its Sasol Delight shops, such as a 2026 winter deal with Tiger Brands on Maynards and Allsorts sweets.
Added partners such as Seattle Coffee Company and Krispy Kreme to its convenience centres from 2023.

companies.name: TotalEnergies Marketing South Africa (Cafe Bonjour shops)
channel_category: petrol station and convenience chains
companies.distributes: Snacks, drinks, groceries and hygiene products in its station shops, plus pastries, sandwiches and pies in Cafe Bonjour
companies.channels_supplied: Cafe Bonjour shops at TotalEnergies service stations nationwide; some sites host OK Express stores
companies.fit_rationale: Its own website says its station stores sell snacks, drinks and groceries alongside the Cafe Bonjour counter, across a network of over 547 service stations. The shop brand is run under one national banner, so it offers a central route into forecourt shops; the number of stations with a Bonjour shop and the buying model are not stated on its website.
what_they_do_well: Runs one of South Africa's larger forecourt networks, with over 547 service stations as of 2025.

companies.name: Big Five Duty Free
channel_category: travel retail
companies.distributes: Duty free retail of liquor, fragrance, cosmetics, tobacco, accessories and confectionery, including chocolate (for example Amarula chocolate and milk chocolate lines)
companies.channels_supplied: Its own duty free stores in international departures and arrivals at OR Tambo, Cape Town, King Shaka and Lanseria airports, plus online pre-order with in-store collection
companies.fit_rationale: The leading duty free operator in South Africa, with stores at the four main international airports and confectionery named as one of its core categories on its own About page. Gebr. Heinemann is a co-shareholder, bringing global confectionery buying, and the OR Tambo revamp is premiumising the confectionery offer, which suits Diablo's gift boxes, chocolate and seasonal packs. No sugar-free range is shown on its website.
what_they_do_well: Described by the Moodie Davitt Report in October 2025 as Sub-Saharan Africa's leading travel retail operator.
Launched Distell's Amarula chocolate in its airport stores (2023).

companies.name: Brittans Sweets
channel_category: travel retail
companies.distributes: Branded chocolate and sweets from other brands such as Cadbury, Hershey, Reese's, Toblerone, Mentos and Hubba Bubba, sold in its airport sweet shops and through online wholesale
companies.channels_supplied: Its own sweet shops in international and domestic departures at Cape Town International Airport, online wholesale orders and franchising
companies.fit_rationale: An airport sweet shop operator that sells other companies' branded chocolate and sweets to travellers, with stores in both departure halls at Cape Town International Airport. It also sells sweets wholesale online and offers franchises, so a new sugar-free line can reach shoppers beyond the airport. Store count and the full range are not stated on its website.
what_they_do_well: Holds sweet shop space in both international and domestic departures at Cape Town International Airport.

companies.name: Sportsmans Warehouse
channel_category: sports shops and sports nutrition shops
companies.distributes: Energy bars, protein bars and sports snacks from USN, PVM, Racefood and Enduren, sold in a Fitness > Supplements > Snacks section
companies.channels_supplied: Own sports stores in malls across South Africa (Mall of Africa, Gateway, Rosebank, Eastgate and more) and its own online shop
companies.sf_brands_carried: USN protein bars and PVM energy bars (better-for-you); no sugar-free confectionery competitor seen
companies.fit_rationale: Calls itself South Africa's largest sports store and already sells branded bars and snacks to health-conscious shoppers in its fitness section. Diablo's muesli and cereal bars and sugar-free snacks fit next to its USN and PVM bars. Store count not stated on its website.
what_they_do_well: Sells bars from several local sports nutrition brands (USN, PVM, Racefood, Enduren) online and in store.

companies.name: Cycle Lab
channel_category: sports shops and sports nutrition shops
companies.distributes: Energy bars and protein bars from PowerBar, PVM, Sponser and Racefood, plus gels and sports drinks
companies.channels_supplied: Own cycling stores in Cape Town, Edenvale, Polokwane, Pretoria, Fourways, Boksburg and Durban, and its own online shop
companies.sf_brands_carried: PowerBar natural protein and cereal bars (better-for-you); no sugar-free confectionery competitor seen
companies.fit_rationale: A multi-store cycling chain with a real bar shelf from several brands, serving endurance athletes who look for cleaner snacks. Diablo's muesli and cereal bars and sugar-free cookies suit its shoppers. Exact store count not stated on its website.
what_they_do_well: Runs megastores such as Fourways and stocks bars from PowerBar, PVM, Sponser and Racefood.

companies.name: Muscle Mecca
channel_category: sports shops and sports nutrition shops
companies.distributes: Protein bars from Barebells and Nutri-Go, a Dubai style chocolate bar, protein drinks and sports supplements
companies.channels_supplied: Ten supplement stores (Cape Town, Centurion, Ermelo, Port Elizabeth, Roodepoort, Greenstone, Nelspruit, Pretoria, Randburg, Secunda) and its own online shop
companies.sf_brands_carried: Barebells protein bars (no added sugar); no direct sugar-free confectionery competitor seen
companies.fit_rationale: A ten-store sports nutrition chain that already sells branded protein bars and calls Barebells and Creme Supreme its lifestyle and functional food brands. Diablo's sugar-free chocolate, Dubai style chocolate and bars fit its health-conscious gym shoppers. It also offers franchises, so new stores may follow.
what_they_do_well: Runs ten sports nutrition stores across South Africa with in-store pickup for online orders.

companies.name: Macgrif (Endurofix)
channel_category: sports shops and sports nutrition shops
companies.distributes: Energy bars (USN, Vooma, Racefood, Naak), energy waffles, chews and gummies (GU), gels and drink mixes
companies.channels_supplied: Its own online shop with delivery across South Africa
companies.sf_brands_carried: USN Zero Sugar hydrator and HIGH5 Zero tabs (drinks only); no sugar-free confectionery competitor seen
companies.fit_rationale: An online endurance nutrition shop with separate bars, waffles and chews and gummies sections from many brands, sold nationwide. Diablo's muesli bars, wafers and sugar-free gummies fit its range for runners and cyclists.
what_they_do_well: Stocks nine endurance brands including GU, HIGH5, Naak, Never Second, Racefood and 32Gi with 1 to 3 day delivery.

companies.name: Bash (TFG)
channel_category: sports shops and sports nutrition shops
companies.distributes: Energy bars from Racefood (Fastbar and Farbar) and sports nutrition from 32Gi and Gloot in its sports and wellness departments
companies.channels_supplied: Online shop of TFG, selling for chains including Totalsports and Sportscene
companies.fit_rationale: TFG's online store sells sports goods for Totalsports and Sportscene and already lists Racefood bars and 32Gi nutrition. Diablo's bars and sugar-free snacks would sit alongside them for sport shoppers. Head office city taken from TFG's public profile; food range is small.
what_they_do_well: Sells for 19 TFG store brands, including Totalsports and Sportscene, from one online shop.

companies.name: Cape Union Mart
channel_category: sports shops and sports nutrition shops
companies.distributes: Snacks and energy bars in its Snacks & Nutrition section, including Racefood bars
companies.channels_supplied: Own outdoor and adventure stores in malls across South Africa (Canal Walk, Cavendish, Fourways Mall, Woodlands) and its own online shop
companies.fit_rationale: A national outdoor and travel chain with its own Snacks & Nutrition category, and Racefood names it as a stockist of its bars. Diablo's muesli bars, cookies and sugar-free sweets suit hikers and travellers. Products in the category did not load in this run, so brands beyond Racefood are not listed here.
what_they_do_well: Racefood lists Cape Union Mart among its national retailers for energy bars.

companies.name: Olympic Cycles
channel_category: sports shops and sports nutrition shops
companies.distributes: Energy bars from Amacx, Cadence, Enduren, GU, HIGH5, Isostar, Maurten, Nutritech, PowerBar, Racefood and Voom, plus gels
companies.channels_supplied: Two cycling stores (Claremont and Kenilworth) and its own online shop
companies.fit_rationale: A Cape Town cycling retailer with a dedicated bars collection of eleven brands sold online nationwide. Diablo's muesli and cereal bars would fit this shelf. Only two stores are shown.
what_they_do_well: Runs one of the widest bar ranges seen in South African cycling retail, with eleven bar brands.

companies.name: CWC (Chris Willemse Cycles)
channel_category: sports shops and sports nutrition shops
companies.distributes: Energy and protein bars from PowerBar, 32Gi and Racefood (Fastbar, Farbar), plus Nakd bars in its brand list and sports supplements
companies.channels_supplied: Own cycling stores (store locator on its website) and its own online shop
companies.fit_rationale: A cycling retailer with a nutrition and confectionery section that sells bars from several brands to endurance shoppers. Diablo's bars and sugar-free snacks fit that section. Store count and head office are not stated on its website.
what_they_do_well: Carries a broad catalogue of about 500 brands, with bars from PowerBar, 32Gi and Racefood.

companies.name: Biket
channel_category: sports shops and sports nutrition shops
companies.distributes: Energy bars from Cadence and PowerBar, plus gels and drink mixes
companies.channels_supplied: One cycling store in Hillcrest, KwaZulu-Natal, and its own online shop with nationwide delivery
companies.fit_rationale: A Trek approved cycling shop with a cycling nutrition section that sells bars from other brands. Diablo's muesli and cereal bars suit its riders. Small, one store.

companies.name: JOC Cycles
channel_category: sports shops and sports nutrition shops
companies.distributes: Energy bars from Amacx, PowerBar and Racefood, with Neversecond and Maurten bar sections
companies.channels_supplied: One cycling store in Mouille Point, Cape Town, and its own online shop
companies.fit_rationale: A premium cycling store with an energy bars section from several brands. Diablo's bars fit next to them. Small, one store.

companies.name: AlphaPharm Nutrition
channel_category: sports shops and sports nutrition shops
companies.distributes: Protein bars in a Snacks, Bars & Drinks section, cream of rice and sports supplements from Applied Nutrition, NPL, TNT Mercury and others
companies.channels_supplied: One store in Randburg and its own online shop with nationwide delivery
companies.fit_rationale: A multi-brand sports nutrition shop with its own snacks and bars section for gym shoppers. Diablo's sugar-free bars, cookies and spreads fit there. Small, one store; bar brands not named on its home page.

companies.name: HealthTwin Supplements & Vitamins
channel_category: sports shops and sports nutrition shops
companies.distributes: Barebells protein bars, Creme Supreme and Gloot products, sports nutrition and vitamins
companies.channels_supplied: One store at Mall @ Reds, Centurion, and its own online shop with delivery across South Africa
companies.fit_rationale: An independent sports nutrition retailer that sells Barebells protein bars and other brands to health-conscious shoppers. Diablo's sugar-free bars and cookies fit its shelf. Small, one store.

companies.name: Epic Sports
channel_category: sports shops and sports nutrition shops
companies.distributes: PowerBar Energize energy bars, gels and HIGH5 and Maurten sports nutrition
companies.channels_supplied: Own sports store and online shop
companies.fit_rationale: A sports and cycling retailer whose online shop sells PowerBar energy bars and other endurance nutrition. Diablo's muesli bars suit its customers. Store count not stated; location from the Cadence Nutrition retailer list.

companies.name: Ridgeway Cycles
channel_category: sports shops and sports nutrition shops
companies.distributes: NamedSport energy bars and Cadence nutrition in its supplements section
companies.channels_supplied: Cycling stores in Greenstone and Edenvale, Johannesburg, and its own online shop
companies.fit_rationale: A cycling retailer that sells energy bars from other brands to riders. Diablo's bars fit this shelf. Small range.

companies.name: Cycleway
channel_category: sports shops and sports nutrition shops
companies.distributes: Energy bars, gels and chews from 32Gi, Cadence and PowerBar in a Bars & Gels section
companies.channels_supplied: One cycling store in Polokwane and its own online shop
companies.fit_rationale: A cycling shop with its own Bars & Gels nutrition section that sells other brands. Diablo's bars and sugar-free gummies suit its riders. Small, one store.

companies.name: Bicycle Line
channel_category: sports shops and sports nutrition shops
companies.distributes: Cadence Carbofuel energy bars and gels
companies.channels_supplied: Cycling shop and coffee bar, and its own online shop
companies.fit_rationale: A cycling shop that sells Cadence energy bars in its nutrition section. Diablo's bars suit its riders. Small, one bar brand; location from the Cadence Nutrition retailer list.

companies.name: Mellow Velo
channel_category: sports shops and sports nutrition shops
companies.distributes: Cadence energy bars in an Energy Bars section, plus gels, chews and recovery drinks
companies.channels_supplied: One cycling store at Broadacres Shopping Centre, Johannesburg, and its own online shop
companies.fit_rationale: A cycling shop with Energy Bars and Chews sections in its hydration and nutrition range. Diablo's bars and sugar-free gummies fit. Small, one store.

companies.name: The Hanger Bike Co
channel_category: sports shops and sports nutrition shops
companies.distributes: Cadence Carbo Fuel energy bars, gels and Torq nutrition
companies.channels_supplied: One cycling store in Somerset West and its own online shop
companies.fit_rationale: A cycling shop that sells Cadence energy bars and other brands' nutrition. Diablo's bars suit its riders. Small, one store.

companies.name: TLC Pantry (The Low Carb Pantry)
channel_category: diabetic, low sugar and keto shops
companies.distributes: Low carb, keto, banting and sugar free foods: sugar free sweets and chocolate (Caring Candies), biscuits and biscotti (Gracious Bakers, Skinny Biscotti), jams (Leo's Little Jars), cakes, cookies, syrups, keto chips and breakfast bars
companies.channels_supplied: Its own shops in Bloubergstrand, Tyger Valley, Somerset West and Tokai, plus its own online shop
companies.sf_brands_carried: Caring Candies, Gracious Bakers, Skinny Biscotti, Leo's Little Jars, We Love Low Carb, Ketos
companies.fit_rationale: A four-store Cape Town specialist for low carb, keto, banting and sugar free shoppers that already sells other brands' sugar free sweets, chocolate, biscuits and jams. Diablo's sugar free chocolate, biscuits, spreads and syrups match the shelves it already has. Caring Candies competes directly in sugar free sweets and chocolate.
what_they_do_well: Runs four low carb shops across Cape Town (Bloubergstrand, Tyger Valley, Somerset West, Tokai) as well as an online shop.

companies.name: The Deli Online
channel_category: diabetic, low sugar and keto shops
companies.distributes: Pantry foods and snacks with Sugar-Free and Banting/Keto sections: sugar free chocolate (Carb Smart), biscuits (Crunch 'n Munch), chocolate nut bars (Karoo), chocolate coated nuts and sweets
companies.channels_supplied: Its own online shop with nationwide delivery and collection from its Durbanville depot
companies.fit_rationale: An online-only food shop with dedicated Sugar-Free and Banting/Keto sections and a Snacks and Sweets section that lists other brands' chocolate, biscuits and bars. Tier 3 because it sells from one depot and much of its pantry range is nuts, seeds and dried fruit; its sugar free chocolate today is only Carb Smart, a direct competitor.
what_they_do_well: Delivers nationwide from its Durbanville depot, with dedicated Sugar-Free and Banting/Keto sections in its online shop.

companies.name: Health Island
channel_category: diabetic, low sugar and keto shops
companies.distributes: Healthy snacks for diabetic, sugar free and low carb customers: snack bars, baked biscuits and rusks, nut and fruit mixes, savoury snacks and nougat in snack boxes and hampers, plus healthy vending
companies.channels_supplied: Its own online shop, corporate snack boxes and hampers delivered across South Africa, and healthy vending machines run through franchisees
companies.fit_rationale: A healthy snack business that sources products from suppliers across the country and sells them as snack boxes, hampers and through healthy vending, with options for diabetic, sugar free and low carb customers. Diablo's bars, cookies and wafers suit its boxes and vending machines. Tier 3 because its website does not name the bar and biscuit brands it carries and gives no store or machine count.
what_they_do_well: Runs healthy vending machines through a franchise model as well as nationwide snack box and hamper delivery.

companies.name: Balans Health
channel_category: gluten free and free from shops
companies.distributes: Sweets and chocolates, protein and snack bars, spreads and snacks, plus health foods, cereals and sweeteners
companies.channels_supplied: Own shop in Brandwag, Bloemfontein and its online shop with nationwide delivery
companies.sf_brands_carried: Caring Candies (sugar free sweets and chocolate), Wedgewood Nougat
companies.fit_rationale: A dietitian-approved health shop with its own Sweets and Chocolates, Protein and Snack Bars and Spreads categories from many other brands, including the sugar free Caring Candies range. Diablo's sugar free chocolate, sweets and bars fit its shelf directly. Store count beyond its Bloemfontein shop is not stated on its website.
what_they_do_well: Stocks around 100 health brands, all described as approved by dietitians and nutritional specialists, with free nationwide delivery over R400.

companies.name: Anadea
channel_category: gluten free and free from shops
companies.distributes: Chocolates, biscuits and rusks, kids snacks, nut butters and spreads, syrups and sweeteners from other brands
companies.channels_supplied: Its online health store with same-day collection in Century City, Cape Town
companies.sf_brands_carried: Nairn's gluten free biscuits, Conscious Kidz dairy free chocolate
companies.fit_rationale: An online natural health store listing over 200 brands, with Chocolates, Biscuits and Rusks and Butters and Spreads subcategories under Food and a gluten free kids snacks range. Diablo's biscuits, chocolate and spreads sit alongside brands it already stocks such as Nairn's.
what_they_do_well: Carries over 200 natural and practitioner brands and holds a 4.8 star rating from 130 Google reviews.

companies.name: Diabetic Accessories South Africa
channel_category: gluten free and free from shops
companies.distributes: Sugar free chocolates and sweets, biscuits and cookies, jam, spreads and rusks for people living with diabetes
companies.channels_supplied: Its online shop with countrywide shipping, and Namibia through Blue Care Dietitians
companies.sf_brands_carried: Stockley's sugar free sweets, Simpkins sugar free sweets
companies.fit_rationale: A diabetes specialist shop whose food categories (chocolates, sweets, biscuits and cookies, jam and spreads) are as large a part of its site as its medical accessories, and it sells branded sugar free sweets such as Stockley's and Simpkins. Tier 3 because it is a small online shop and its head office town is not stated on its website.
what_they_do_well: Ships countrywide and reaches Namibia through a dietitian stockist, Blue Care Dietitians.

companies.name: The Deli
channel_category: gluten free and free from shops
companies.distributes: Snacks and sweets, sugar free chocolate, chocolate nut bars and biscuits in gluten free, sugar free and keto collections
companies.channels_supplied: Its online shop with nationwide delivery and a reduced rate for Cape Town
companies.sf_brands_carried: Carb Smart sugar free chocolate, Grumpy Snacks, Karoo
companies.fit_rationale: An online health pantry with dedicated Gluten Free, Sugar Free and Banting Keto collections that already sells other brands' sugar free chocolate (Carb Smart) and chocolate snacks and bars (Karoo, Grumpy Snacks). Tier 3 because much of its range is bulk nuts and seeds and its store details are not shown on its website.
